open_questions: The engine has no workshop model, so the no-earn flag checks built workshops in the station's system and their recipe inputs inside cash_forecast.gd (reads workshops/Goods only). Move it into the engine if you want it there. Untested with a built workshop.
A lane with no sale into a planet is flagged only when nothing there sells or sends the good on. Is that the wanted rule?
Paused-before-first-cycle is not treated as unreliable: the forecast is valid while paused. Say if you want the cost label there.
handoff: Lane label now shows net per cycle from engine.forecast(): sale at destination Sell order (units * price) + route bonus - source Buy cost - trip - upkeep. Lanes sharing an order split it by units carried (units * min(1, order units / all lane units)); stock already there and mixed bonus belong to no lane. Sum of lane nets + (order credits - lane sales + lane costs) = forecast total (tested). Green/red/plain at 0; fallback 'cost -72' when the lane moves nothing (stalled, waiting, blocked). Forecast popup adds an amber line under Expenses for a moving lane with no sale. New ids LBL_ROUTE_COST, LBL_FC_NO_EARN. Tests 1788 pass, 0 fail.

details.how_to_try: qa/run_game.sh res://qa/bots/lane_net_shot.gd (shots in qa/reports/). In game: set a Sell order at one planet, a Buy order at another, Send to the first, Send to Space Storage; read lane labels; click the money text for the forecast.
details.attribution_rule: lane net = sale + gross(route bonus + stop sale) - cost - paid fare. sale = units carried * min(1, units the destination Sell order really sells / units all lanes carry there) * sold_price; cost likewise at the source Buy order; 0 when no order. Multi-ship lanes sum their moving ships.
